cases.prompt: Turn on guard mode, I'm touching prod and want maximum safety.

assertions.text: Warns before destructive commands like rm -rf, DROP TABLE, and force-push (the /careful behavior)
Blocks edits outside a specified directory (the /freeze behavior)
Produces combined safety guardrails: destructive warnings plus edit scope lock

cases.prompt: 라이브 시스템 디버깅 중이야. full safety 모드로 잠가줘.

assertions.text: Runs a PreToolUse Bash check for destructive commands before they execute
Engages full safety mode combining destructive-command warnings with directory-scoped edits

cases.prompt: Does guard mode actually run its hooks on Windows, and what happens if the careful folder is missing?

assertions.text: States that guard runs bash "$HOME/.claude/skills/careful/bin/check-careful.sh" for Bash and bash "$HOME/.claude/skills/freeze/bin/check-freeze.sh" for Edit and Write.
Checks that careful and freeze are installed under ~/.claude/skills before setting the boundary, because a hook whose script is missing cannot start and blocks nothing.
Distinguishes deny (blocks, HIGH commands, out-of-boundary edits and hook failures) from ask (confirmation prompt for MEDIUM commands).
